root_recipe.human_authorization: Sustained autonomous broad GeoBC solver selection; solver not selected, no Hash micro-tuning
root_recipe.stress_route_eligibility: Both new matched stress heads failed DEV gates; no S route selected. All new-test S targets remain sealed. FNO internal4 output allowed, only U decode/persist/metrics.

physical_route.fine_equation: Accepted original curved TET10 fourQ full equation, FP64 true residual convergence
physical_route.preconditioner: Accepted P1-derived fixed32 additive space while solving full fine equation; no direct coarse field substitution
physical_route.geometry_regularity: Preserve accepted elastic_pilot center+fourQ coherent nonzero signed orientation, including consistently negative orientation with positive abs(detJ) quadrature weights, plus corresponding existing native query policy. No new positive-sign-only rule, P1 substitution, dropped cells or source-H3D claim.

before_any_new_test_parse: Final formal plan binds final sources/checkpoint/scaler/seed/query/full budgets and exact identities
Authentic root source review/release marker after source-ready; no source preparation raw/header/array or weight reads
root_recipe.FNO_interpretation: Same original-node U metrics; independently report same nodeU1% gate, input and training/cost differences explicit. No native-gradient claim or family capacity ranking. No whole-GeoBC selection from U-only result.
root_recipe.costs: Fresh raw-to-field cost each interface; acquisition and upstream CAD meshing excluded explicitly; all parse/setup/solve/FNO checkpoint/H2D/inference/query/IO charged; target/metrics and offline training separate; do not borrow historical31-42s. Ten GPU-serial independent child requests, one per arm/CAD; parent launch-to-observed-exit counts true cold and failed time. Fixed FNO cap120s. Persist physical fullfourQ U/G before labels; later metric child reuses these candidate outputs, no re-solve. Source U parses5 and subsequent owned GT-cache accesses must be separate actual receipt counts.
root_recipe.scope_rule: One frozen blind protocol; no replacing cases, dropping failures, retuning recipe or consuming S to rescue. This is service evidence across unseen IDs, not established unseen geometry families.

physical_recipe.units: mm, N, MPa, displacement mm, strain dimensionless
physical_recipe.continuum: isotropic small-strain linear elasticity, full TET10 displacement and curved geometry
physical_recipe.quadrature: four symmetric (a,b,b,b) permutations; a=(5+3sqrt(5))/20, b=(5-sqrt(5))/20; each weight1/24

reader_scope.coordinates: GRID CP=CD=0 after actual GRDSET expansion; explicit zero overrides default; nonzero systems unsupported
reader_scope.material: All CTETRA mapped through PSOLID to one validated isotropic MAT1; E>0,-1<nu<0.5; explicitG consistency relative1e-8
reader_scope.constraints: Initial specialization: every support RBE2 master constrained123456=0; CM includes123; member translations derived zero. Direct123 zero SPC/PS supported. No unrestrained master, nonzero prescribed motion or unsupported constraint algebra
reader_scope.reduction: u=Tz with free-node identity blocks and exact derived-zero supported translations; no role-flag constraints
reader_scope.rbe3: One loaded reference, translational member Ci=123, positive actual weights, no UM; published weighted-LS rigid-fit is an explicit new approximation
reader_scope.control_policy: Parse all small/free-field cards. Record explicitly allowlisted output/static-irrelevant controls. Do not reproduce original numerical/integration/autoconstraint settings. Unknown active material/load/constraint/contact cards cause an explicit unsupported result
reader_scope.grid_ids: Actual canonical GRID IDs map to original H5 rows; no ID-1 assumption or nearest-node remapping
reader_scope.ctetra_check: Every cached cell covered by deck CTETRA/material, preserving full corner-midpoint edge associations
reader_scope.parameter_semantics: POST/output record-only. AUTOSPC is not reproduced: no automatic constraints; unsupported free zero-energy DOFs rejected. CHECKEL NO recorded but own mathematical guards retained. RENUMOK YES recorded without input resequencing or geometry repair. PRINFACC 1 output only. CONTFEL AUTO and GAPCMPL NO excluded only under this no-contact/no-gap-element specialization; unknown active contact cards rejected. GAPCMPL NO does not disable contact. Unselected modal METHOD/EIGRL preserved but excluded; selected static METHOD rejected. Exact DEBUG LGSHPSNS 0.0 explicitly not reproduced with original effect unknown. No OptiStruct numerical/integration equivalence claim.
